html:
The Gaza war began on 7 October 2023, when Hamas fighters broke out of Gaza into southern Israel, killing about 1,200 people, most of them civilians, and taking about 250 hostages. It was the deadliest day in Israel's history.

Israel answered with a massive bombing campaign and a ground invasion of the Gaza Strip. Tens of thousands of Palestinians were killed, many of them women and children, most of Gaza's buildings were damaged or destroyed, and nearly all of its two million people were driven from their homes. In August 2025 famine was declared in Gaza City.

The war spread to Lebanon, where Israel fought Hezbollah, and to Iran and Yemen. A ceasefire and exchange of hostages and prisoners began in October 2025. See also occupied territories.
